name: lumina-sh

input.name: image
input.encoding: sRGB-encoded RGB in 0..1, NCHW, centre-cropped to 4:3

output.name: sh
output.meaning: linear radiance SH9 (three.js basis), camera frame, exposure-relative

training.checkpoint_rule: EMA weights of the step-29,000 checkpoint (last.pt) of a run launched with --steps 50000 and stopped at about step 29,000; chosen by the lowest validation sRGB RMSE among the saved checkpoints (steps 2,000, 10,000 and 29,000; 39.7 vs 41.2 vs 67.3), not by test-set results
training.reproduction_note: Launch command of the run. The run was stopped at about step 29,000 before its 50,000-step schedule finished, so the weights are the 29,000-step state of that schedule; --steps 29000 would not reproduce them (the learning-rate schedule is set by --steps).
